verdict.rationale: Elastic documents collecting all three signal types in one platform: metrics from OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, or Elastic Agent; logs searched in Discover; and APM traces across microservices. The overview describes unifying logs, metrics, and traces. Pivoting between those signals with shared context is barely evidenced: only a tie between RUM/synthetics and back-end telemetry, and a natural-language claim about not switching context. missing for 10: documented trace-to-log and metric-to-trace correlation or navigation, shared identifiers or context propagation across signals, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context

citations.quote: Ingest metrics from any source using OpenTelemetry, Prometheus remote write, or Elastic Agent integrations.
search, filter, and tail all your logs ingested into your project in one place
Elastic APM traces every request across microservices and APIs pinpointing code-level latency.
Unify logs, metrics, traces, user experience data
Real user monitoring and synthetic testing are tied to SLOs and back end telemetry.
Elastic APM agents automatically pick up basic host-level metrics
